parts:
Maybe Bob has some idea. Here is what we know:
  • That code compiles fine with stanc but not Rcpp::sourceCpp, so it must have something to do with taking the function out of the model namespace and into the global namespace
  • But that code compiles fine with Rcpp::sourceCpp on g++ >= 4.6 and clang++ and icpc, so it is probably valid code in the global namespace
  • It claims "ile505465f21f2b.cpp:47: error: reference to ‘vector_d’ is ambiguous" but then goes on to list exactly one candidate
  • So perhaps the underlying problem is really later when it gives the additional error

file505465f21f2b.cpp:53: error: no matching function for call to ‘get_base1_lhs(vector_d (&)(const int&, const double&, const vector_d&), int&, const char [7], int)’
file505465f21f2b.cpp:56: error: conversion from ‘double’ to non-scalar type ‘vector_d’ requested

Ben
